title: Fibre Channel FC-1 / FC-2 port: 8b/10b, ordered sets, class 3 frames, buffer-to-buffer credit

fields.desc: BB_credit of the far end: frames that may be outstanding (0 = no check)

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Transmit byte (header first; the port adds SOF, fill, CRC and EOF); a frame starts once its first byte is in TX, and each next byte must arrive within a character time (10 PCLK)

fdesc.tx_sofi: with the first byte: SOFi3 (else SOFn3)
fdesc.tx_eoft: with the last byte: EOFt (else EOFn)

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Received byte (CRC removed); read it within a character time (10 PCLK)

fdesc.rx_stat: with rx_last: {sofi, eoft, abort, len_err, crc_err}

fields.desc: the receiver is word-aligned and has seen three ordered sets
frames sent and not yet answered by R_RDY

irqs.name: TX_UNDERRUN
irqs.desc: a transmit byte was late: the frame was ended with EOFa

irqs.name: RX_FRAG
irqs.desc: a frame of fewer than 5 bytes was received and dropped

irqs.name: ERR_CODE
irqs.desc: a code violation, disparity error or misplaced K character (alignment lost)

irqs.name: ERR_WORD
irqs.desc: a data word or an EOF outside a frame

notes: tx_p and rx_p are the serial line pins (one bit per PCLK); they pass through unchanged.
